task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

calls.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: ChainResponse(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) requires the switch to be toggled on the very next step after every step the siren is ringing. The task requires turning it off each time it starts ringing, but does not require an immediate toggle. Use Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) to allow turning it off later during that ring.
NO CHANGES NEEDED: hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) requires turning off each ring; the toggle ends the ringing and satisfies the pending response.
